literal: Swiftly having looked themselves, they themselves weep; this to laugh fit thing possesses.
translation: My eyes eagerly looked at him themselves, and now they themselves weep. This situation is truly fit to be laughed at.
modern: விரைந்து சென்று தாமே அவரைப் பார்த்துவிட்டு, இப்போது தாமே அழுகின்ற என் கண்களின் இந்த நிலைமை சிரிக்கத் தக்கதாக இருக்கிறது.
explanation: The heroine speaks about her pining eyes, pointing out the irony of their situation. She notes that her eyes eagerly sought out her lover on their own, but now they are the ones weeping because of his absence. The word 'கதுமென' means swiftly or eagerly, highlighting their initial haste. She concludes that this self-inflicted suffering possesses a nature ('உடைத்து') that is fit only to be laughed at ('நகத் தக்கது').
